newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends lower on heavyweights.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends lower on heavyweights.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended lower on Wednesday under the weight of selected market heavyweights but the downside was capped by bargain hunters, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 1.47 percent, or 8.46 points, to close at 566.32 points after touching an intra-day low of 563.31 points.
Losers led gainers by 64 to 37, with 62 issues unchanged.
"Selling pressure on certain stocks are likely to continue on Thursday and is likely to give a negative tone to market sentiment," said one foreign broker.
Secondliner Hotel Sahid Jaya topped the active list with 7.2 million shares changing hands. Brokers said it was due to market talk of possible takeover.
